svg.title: Pedro Grilo, Senior Frontend Engineer
svg.desc: Senior Frontend Engineer based in Lisbon, Portugal. I build fast, accessible interfaces with React, Vue.js and TypeScript. Real-time, collaborative map editors with CRDTs and WebSockets. After hours: Rust + Tauri desktop apps and Home Assistant hacks.
